learning_objective: 🏃‍♂️ Master your speedy footwork, learn to balance on one leg perfectly, and move around with super agility and joy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Let us practice walking very softly on our tip-toes! Keep your body straight, take small little steps, and try not to make a single sound.
Running in straight lines is easy, but dodging is tricky! Bend your knees slightly, push off your toes, and run in a zig-zag pattern around your friends or cones.
Time for some Yoga! Stand tall, lift one foot, and rest it on your other leg. Stretch your arms up high like branches and stay completely still for 10 seconds.

fun_activity.title: 🌋 The Lava Floor Jump
fun_activity.instructions: Place three pillows safely on the floor. Pretend the floor is hot lava! Jump from one pillow to the next using little steps and try not to fall off.

quick_recap: ⭐ Use small tip-toe steps to move quietly and quickly like a ninja.
⭐ Bend your knees to help you change directions fast while running.
⭐ Focus your eyes on one spot to help you balance on one leg perfectly.
